Street guides / 03

A café sign is only the beginning

Follow 카페 to the door, then use 커피, 차, and 디저트 to make sense of the menu.

Updated 2 October 2026

카페

Understand the place

카페 identifies a café; 커피 means coffee. A shop can display either word on its outside sign. Inside, menu headings often organize drinks and food. 차 means tea in a drink-menu context, while 디저트 identifies desserts. 빵집 is a bakery, with bread as the main clue.

Easy to mix up

차 also has other meanings, including a vehicle. A cup, drink names, and a café menu help you choose the tea meaning. 빵집 and 카페 can offer overlapping products, so the sign is a useful starting point rather than a complete menu.

A sign you might see

A board reads 커피 · 차 · 디저트. Read it as three categories: coffee, tea, and dessert. You have identified what to look at next, but not the exact ingredients, price, or size. Those details belong to the individual menu item.

Read in this order

  1. Read the outside place word first. 카페 suggests a café; 빵집 suggests a bakery. Products may overlap, so keep looking.
  2. On a menu, identify the category before a specific item. 커피, 차, and 디저트 help you find the part you want.
  3. Use the surrounding words or pictures to resolve ambiguous words. Then check the individual item's details instead of treating the heading as a full description.

Three signs, three decisions

Fictional sign examples

카페 · 커피

카페 names the place and 커피 names a drink. A sign can contain both. Recognizing coffee is useful, but it does not specify whether a particular drink is hot, iced, sweetened, or available today.

차 · 디저트

On this fictional café menu, 차 and 디저트 label tea and desserts. The menu context gives 차 its tea meaning. A nearby drawing of a vehicle in a different setting could point you toward another meaning instead.

빵집 · 휴무

빵집 still names a bakery even when 휴무 says it is closed or taking a day off. Bread in the window is a place clue, while the status notice is the clue that changes whether you should try the door.

What the sign cannot tell you

Reading 차 as 'car' everywhere would make the café menu confusing. Reading it as 'tea' everywhere would also be a mistake. Begin with the setting and nearby words, then choose the meaning that fits. Familiar letters can carry different meanings.

Check your understanding

1. Which word should you look for when you want coffee?

Show answer and explanation

커피 is coffee. 차 can mean tea in this setting; 빵집 is a bakery. Match the word to the drink you want, not simply to the building you are inside.

2. On a café's drinks menu, can 차 mean tea?

Show answer and explanation

Yes. The drink-menu context supports the tea meaning. This does not mean 차 always means tea: a different setting can support a different meaning.

Try it on your next walk

Find 카페, then choose a category you would order from. Say 커피 or 차 before revealing the translation. Listen again and notice how a familiar drink becomes a readable Korean word.
